description: This file provides helper functions for gateway discovery, including resolving service hosts, constructing service endpoints, SSH targets, and gateway URLs based on discovered gateway data.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost
methods.description: Resolves and trims the service host string from a DiscoveredGateway object.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost
methods.description: Trims and validates a host string.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs a network endpoint (host and port) from a GatewayDiscoveredGateway object.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a network endpoint from given host and port strings, validating the port.

methods.name: sshTarget
methods.description: Generates an SSH target string for connecting to the gateway.

methods.name: directUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for direct gateway access.

methods.name: directGatewayUrl
methods.description: Builds a secure websocket URL for the gateway, choosing scheme based on host.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Helper function to trim whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Determines if a given host string refers to a loopback address.
